title: Observation
description: One measurement event, typed by what was measured (concept §13). Chemical contents, male behaviour and antennal responses are different observations, never one record with a 'role' field.

observation_id.description: spa.obs.<taxon slug>.<reference slug>.<what was measured>, the slugs being the record's taxon_id and reference_id without their prefixes (checked: OBS_ID); permanent (docs/identifiers.md)

taxon_name_as_reported.description: the binomial the source used, e.g. 'Aegeria apiformis' (Kovalev 1988) for spa.tax.sesia_apiformis; must be the taxon's accepted name or one of its synonyms (NAME_AS_REPORTED). A later change of combination never rewrites what a paper called its moth

experiment_id.description: the field trial or run the record comes from, spa.exp.<reference slug>.<experiment>, so records sharing traps or controls can be joined (EXP_ID). A list only when the source pools trials into one result. Required on behavioural_response

source_location.description: where in the source this was read, e.g. 'abstract', 'Table 2'

author_statement.description: the authors' own short wording of the result, kept apart from the Atlas's reading. A short quotation from the source, under the source's own terms, not relicensed by the Atlas (LICENSE-DATA.md)

author_statement_form.description: absent means verbatim. source_translation: the source's own translation (e.g. an English summary); curator_translation: the Atlas curator's; paraphrase: not the authors' words at all

unresolved.description: what this record needs and the source as read does not give: missing evidence, stated explicitly

notes.description: the Atlas's notes and inferences, never the authors'

trap.description: only when the comparator's trap differs from the treatment's

dispenser.description: only when the comparator's dispenser differs from the treatment's

effect.description: relative to the comparator; caught_without_control means males were caught and no comparator was run. With significance not_tested, effect is the direction of the raw means, so equal numbers always get the same label; the authors' own reading, if any, is in author_statement

significance.description: not_tested: the paper ran no test on this contrast, e.g. a zero-catch treatment left out of the ANOVA

dose.description: total load per lure, when given

response.description: the size of the effect, when the source gives one
inconsistent: the authors report responses in some recordings and not others

rearing.description: field_collected_reared: collected as larvae or pupae, adults emerged in the laboratory

sampling_unit.description: pooled extract or single insects; ratios can differ between the two

sample.description: what was chemically measured. A paper that reports matrices separately gives one observation per matrix; several materials in one record mean the paper reports only a combined result, never that it was shown in each

materials.description: gland_extract: solvent extract of the gland or abdominal tip; effluvium: volatiles released by the insect, however collected (headspace, adsorbent, SPME near the gland); the collection method is in each component's method

material_as_reported.description: the source's own wording, kept because the vocabulary loses nuance

quantity.description: a known amount. An unknown amount is no quantity at all: omit the object rather than fill it with nulls

unit.description: one spelling per unit, so doses and detection limits compare without parsing

detected.description: not_tested is unknown; false is a negative and needs a method

method.description: how presence or absence was established

identification.description: as the authors state it: tentative when they call it tentative (e.g. Yang 2011 for retention-index-only matches), confirmed when they present it as identified; method and notes say what it rests on, e.g. geometry from retention on one polar column

purity.description: purity of the synthetic in the lure. Chemical and isomeric purity are different claims: a compound can be free of geometric isomers and still only 83 % pure

basis.description: measured by the authors, or stated by them or a supplier without data

dispenser.description: what carries the lure; release rate depends on it as much as on the load

description.description: as given, e.g. 'red rubber sleeve stopper, 7 x 11 mm'

design.description: funnel includes the universal moth trap (Unitrap); bucket is a bucket trap as the authors name it

colour_lab.description: CIE L*a*b* of the trap surface, when measured
